# Quotation response -- DKS-2026-007

Visakoivu Oy

## 3. Eligibility

3.2 Visakoivu Oy's equity ratio comfortably exceeds the 20% threshold set out in this section, based on our most recent financial statements.

3.3 Visakoivu employs well in excess of the 15 electrical professionals required, as part of our wider technical workforce across LVI, sahko, rakennusautomaatio and kiinteistonhoito.

## 4. Technical requirements

4.1 Our proposed HVAC (LVI) maintenance agreement covers scheduled preventive visits and responsive corrective works across the facility's mechanical plant, with visit frequency agreed at contract start.

4.2 A site-specific occupational safety plan will be prepared for the facility in line with our standard site-safety procedures, covering hazard identification and access arrangements specific to a data-centre environment.

4.3 Fire-protection systems will be maintained on a regular inspection and testing schedule appropriate to a data-centre environment, with results documented after each visit.

4.4 Equipment installed under this contract will carry a standard manufacturer-aligned warranty period.

4.7 Spare parts for common items are held in stock; parts not held are sourced promptly through our established supplier network.

4.8 Environmental matters during the works will be managed in accordance with our environmental management practices.

4.9 Our personnel will follow the buyer's access-control and site-security procedures at all times while on site, including any escort or badge requirements the buyer specifies.

## 5. Commercial terms

5.1 Visakoivu's standard limitation-of-liability clause will apply, details available on request.

5.2 All prices are quoted in EUR.

5.3 A modest retention percentage applies to invoices under this agreement, in line with our standard commercial terms.

5.4 A discount structure is available against the overall volume of the framework agreement, to be agreed with the buyer during contract negotiation.

## 6. Enclosures

6.2 A certificate of Visakoivu's pension insurance payments is enclosed.

## 7. Format

7.1 Pricing is quoted per square metre.

7.2 This quotation is submitted as a single, non-password-protected PDF.

7.3 Prices are quoted in EUR per square metre per year.

## Liite A

A.2 Our building automation capability is compatible with the standard protocols used in facilities of this type, including BACnet and Modbus.

A.3 A prompt response time is offered for fault reports, supported by a standby (on-call) arrangement outside normal working hours.

A.4 Routine maintenance visits will be scheduled and their content agreed with the buyer at contract start.

## Liite B

B.1 A bonus/malus arrangement against the Section 4 service levels can be agreed with the buyer as part of contract finalisation.
